files.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools==80.9.0", "wheel==0.45.1"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "alpha-factory-v1"
version = "1.45.0"
description = "AGIALPHA Agent: evidence-driven missions, evolutionary optimization and operator controls"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.14"
license = "Apache-2.0"
dependencies = [
    "cryptography>=50.0.1,<51",
    "fastapi>=0.116,<1",
    "httpx>=0.28,<1",
    "numpy>=2.2,<2.5",
    "pydantic>=2.11,<3",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.10,<3",
    "PyYAML>=6,<7",
    "uvicorn>=0.35,<1",
    "prometheus-client>=0.19,<1",
]

[tool.setuptools]
include-package-data = true

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["alpha_factory_v1*", "af_requests*", "openai_agents*"]
exclude = ["*.node_modules*", "*.tests*", "*.test*", "*.build*", "*.wasm*", "*.dist*", "*.presentation*", "*.venv*"]
namespaces = true

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.sovereign_agentic_agialpha_agent_v0" = ["*.sh", "*.html", "web/*", "archive/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1" = ["py.typed", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.yml", "**/*.json", "**/*.proto", "**/*.txt", "**/*.md"]
"alpha_factory_v1.core.runtime" = ["web/*", "examples/*.json"]
"alpha_factory_v1.core.runtime.successor" = ["schemas.json", "canonical-vectors.json", "workbench_worker.mjs", "workbench_sources.json", "workbench_LICENSE.txt"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.macro_sentinel" = ["offline_samples/*.csv"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.finance_alpha" = ["*.sh", "*.ipynb", "web/*", "archive/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.muzeromctsllmagent_v0" = ["*.sh", "*.html", "requirements-*.txt", "archive/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.muzero_planning" = ["requirements.lock", "Dockerfile", "*.sh", "*.ipynb", "archive/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.meta_agentic_agi_v3" = ["configs/*.csv", "web/meta_agentic_agi_v3/*", "web/assets/*/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.meta_agentic_tree_search_v0" = ["web/meta_agentic_tree_search_v0/*", "web/assets/*/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.era_of_experience" = ["offline_samples/*.csv", "web/era_of_experience/*", "web/assets/*/*"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_insight_v1" = ["py.typed"]
"alpha_factory_v1.core.interface.web_client" = ["dist/**"]
"alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_insight_v1.src.interface.web_client" = ["dist/**"]

[tool.setuptools.exclude-package-data]
"*" = ["**/node_modules/**", "**/__pycache__/**", "**/.venv/**", "**/venv/**"]

[project.scripts]
alpha-agent = "alpha_factory_v1.core.runtime.cli:main"
alpha-factory = "alpha_factory_v1.run:run"
insight-workbench = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_insight_v0.discovery_cli:main"
curriculum-lab = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.meta_agentic_agi_v3.lab_cli:main"
mats-lab = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.meta_agentic_tree_search_v0.lab_cli:main"
experience-lab = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.era_of_experience.lab_cli:main"
governance-workbench = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.solving_agi_governance.cli:main"
governance-sim = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.solving_agi_governance.governance_sim:main"
edge-runner = "alpha_factory_v1.edge_runner:main"
alpha-asi-demo = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_asi_world_model.alpha_asi_world_model_demo:_main"
validate-demos = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.validate_demos:main"
aiga-meta-demo = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.aiga_meta_evolution.meta_evolver:cli"
muzero-demo = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.muzero_planning.agent_muzero_entrypoint:launch_dashboard"
alpha-agi-business-3-v1 = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_business_3_v1.cli:main"
alpha-agi-insight-v1 = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_insight_v1.src.interface.cli:main"
alpha-agi-insight-v1-api = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_insight_v1.src.interface.api_server:main"
aii = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.alpha_agi_insight_v1.src.interface.cli:main"
verify-wheel-sig = "alpha_factory_v1.scripts.verify_wheel_sig:main"
mats-demo = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.meta_agentic_tree_search_v0.run_demo:main"
mats-bridge = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.meta_agentic_tree_search_v0.openai_agents_bridge:main"
governance-bridge = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.solving_agi_governance.openai_agents_bridge:main"
macro-sentinel = "alpha_factory_v1.demos.macro_sentinel.agent_macro_entrypoint:launch_ui"

[project.optional-dependencies]
chain = ["eth-account>=0.13.7,<0.14"]
tests = [
    "pytest",
]

[project.entry-points."alpha_factory.agents"]
# custom agents can be registered here

[tool.black]
line-length = 120

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
target-version = "py311"
exclude = [
    ".cache",
    ".git",
    # exclude all demo directories except MuZero planning
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/aiga_meta_evolution/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/alpha_agi_business_2_v1/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/alpha_agi_business_v1/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/alpha_agi_insight_v0/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/alpha_agi_marketplace_v1/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/finance_alpha/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/macro_sentinel/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/meta_agentic_agi/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/meta_agentic_agi_v2/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/meta_agentic_agi_v3/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/meta_agentic_tree_search_v0/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/muzeromctsllmagent_v0/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/omni_factory_demo/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/self_healing_repo_cli.py",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/solving_agi_governance/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/sovereign_agentic_agialpha_agent_v0/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/tests/*",
    "*.ipynb",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
extend-ignore = ["E402", "F401", "E401"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"contrib/strategy_succession/worker/scientific/companion/specialist.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"contrib/strategy_succession/worker/scientific/review/check.py" = ["F841"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/companion/analyze.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/companion/specialist.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/history/audit_original.py" = ["E701"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/history/current-exact-replay/replay_original.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/paper/make_result_figures.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/publication/build_docket.py" = ["E701"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/publication/build_verification.py" = ["E701"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/results/confirmation-v1/audit/derive_acquisition_audit.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/results/confirmation-v1/audit/derive_selected_lineage.py" = ["E701", "E702"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/review/check.py" = ["F841"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/review/results/audit_main.py" = ["E701", "E702", "F841"]
"studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/scripts/freeze_study.py" = ["E701", "E702"]

[tool.flake8]
max-line-length = 120

[tool.coverage.run]
omit = [
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/backend/agents/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/backend/memory*",
    "/tmp/*",
    "*/tmp/*",
]

# Apply the same existing scope to data collected by test subprocesses.
[tool.coverage.report]
omit = [
    "alpha_factory_v1/demos/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/backend/agents/*",
    "alpha_factory_v1/backend/memory*",
    "/tmp/*",
    "*/tmp/*",
]

[tool.mutmut]
# Merge-safe mutation smoke scope. This intentionally targets a bounded,
# high-signal Python surface so push-to-main runs stay deterministic.
paths_to_mutate = ["scripts/mutation_smoke_target.py"]
pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection = "tests/test_mutation_smoke_target.py"
pytest_add_cli_args = "-q"
mutate_only_covered_lines = true
max_stack_depth = 12
do_not_mutate = [
    "*/__init__.py",
    "*/SCRATCHPAD.md",
]
